{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm (only 2)
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Compute mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = df_clean.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Print each mean value individually, ensuring they are captured from actual output
print(f'Adelie mean flipper length: {mean_flipper_by_species["Adelie"]:.2f}')
print(f'Chinstrap mean flipper length: {mean_flipper_by_species["Chinstrap"]:.2f}')
print(f'Gentoo mean flipper length: {mean_flipper_by_species["Gentoo"]:.2f}')

# Find the species with the highest mean
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()
highest_mean_value = mean_flipper_by_species.max()

print(f'\nSpecies with highest mean flipper length: {highest_mean_species} ({highest_mean_value:.2f} mm)')"}
